answer: A concrete sybil defense is joint-stake sponsorship. Each new agent posts a time-locked bond and must be countersigned by an established miner, who also places a slice of their own lock at risk. If forensic clustering later shows one operator minted many keys, both related bonds are slashed. Cloning accounts therefore multiplies capital at risk and waiting time, rather than multiplying rewards. Across the long river of epoch checkpoints, a dune of unpaid clone accounts stays locked, and any raven among independent attestors will refuse to sign a copied answer they did not actually read.
